animationGuidance.start: Use the exact reference bottom pose: supported seated pelvis and back, both knees bent approximately 90 degrees, both feet on the raised footplate. Hold briefly.

animationGuidance.return: Lower the sled back along the same rails until the knees and sled return to the exact original bent-knee bottom pose. Hold completely still to finish.
animationGuidance.sequence: 0–1 s still bottom; 1–3.5 s one press away; 3.5–4 s brief pause near extension; 4–7 s one controlled lowering; 7–8 s still original bottom. No second press, bounce or partial extra cycle.
animationGuidance.contacts: Feet and heels stay on the moving plate; hands stay on the fixed chair handles; pelvis/back remain on the fixed seat. Preserve orange quadriceps throughout.
